dialogo.speaker: Olivia
dialogo.text: You live on the west coast, right?
dialogo.translation: Você mora na costa oeste, certo?

dialogo.speaker: Corey
dialogo.text: Yes. Our house is on the sea in southern California.
dialogo.translation: Sim. Nossa casa fica no mar, no sul da Califórnia.

dialogo.speaker: Olivia
dialogo.text: Is it hot or cold there? I live on the other side of the country, on the east coast, and we have a lot of cold weather.
dialogo.translation: Está quente ou frio lá? Eu moro do outro lado do país, na costa leste, e temos muito tempo frio.

dialogo.speaker: Corey
dialogo.text: It's mostly warm, but up in the mountains it can get cooler.
dialogo.translation: É principalmente quente, mas nas montanhas pode ficar mais fresco.

dialogo.speaker: Olivia
dialogo.text: We have about six months of nice weather here.
dialogo.translation: Temos cerca de seis meses de clima agradável aqui.

dialogo.speaker: Corey
dialogo.text: Do you prefer summer or winter?

dialogo.speaker: Olivia
dialogo.text: Actually I prefer both spring and fall because the weather isn't so extreme.
dialogo.translation: Na verdade, prefiro tanto a primavera quanto o outono, porque o clima não é tão extremo.

dialogo.speaker: Corey
dialogo.text: That makes sense. I like summer weather best. We plant a garden every year.
dialogo.translation: Faz sentido. Eu gosto mais do clima de verão. Plantamos uma horta todo ano.

dialogo.speaker: Olivia
dialogo.text: I would love to grow some herbs this summer.
dialogo.translation: Eu adoraria cultivar algumas ervas neste verão.

dialogo.speaker: Corey
dialogo.text: You should try. You just need to make sure to water them.
dialogo.translation: Você deveria tentar. Só precisa se certificar de regá-las.

dialogo.speaker: Olivia
dialogo.text: I may need to ask you for help.
dialogo.translation: Talvez eu precise pedir sua ajuda.

dialogo.speaker: Corey
dialogo.text: I'll be here, call me if you need anything.
dialogo.translation: Estarei aqui, me ligue se precisar de algo.
